requested_delta: Add a bounded machine-readable external transport trace below the worker-facing interface so external_read_ops, external_write_ops, workflow_waits and retries become numeric only when the trace declares externally evidenced COMPLETE_FOR_SCOPE coverage.
must_preserve: Worker-facing ABI remains unchanged; no new worker handshake.
Local reasoning and local deterministic work are never transport operations.
Observable counters are coalesced into one productive-unit accounting record rather than persisted per local operation.
UNKNOWN remains the required value whenever coverage is not COMPLETE_FOR_SCOPE.
Numeric zero remains legal only with closed coverage evidence.
Candidate, verified evidence and CURRENT remain distinct.
forbidden_regressions: Inventing zero from missing trace events.
Using model self-report as external counter authority.
Generating a Git commit or telemetry write for every local reasoning/tool-independent operation.
Mutating WORKER_PIPELINE, scheduler, queue, Current or worker-facing ABI.
Promoting the accounting candidate from this bounded implementation test.

experiment_or_test.control: Existing real closed lifecycle record keeps external reads/writes/waits/retries UNKNOWN where no closed per-operation transport trace exists.
experiment_or_test.candidate: Synthetic closed trace produces exact counters; closed zero trace produces evidenced zeros; a minimal real partial sample remains UNKNOWN with only an observed minimum.

promotion_gate: Fixture harness passes all closed/zero/partial cases.
Minimal real sample does not claim complete transport coverage.
No baseline authority file is promoted or replaced.
rollback: Delete only the new candidate trace contract, summarizer, fixture/test/workflow and evidence created by WORKER-IO-TRANSPORT-TRACE-V1; baseline accounting files remain byte-identical.
truth_boundary: Candidate observability extension only. This work may prove trace semantics and a bounded harness; it does not prove the ChatGPT/GitHub connector exposes a complete real transport trace and does not promote WORKER_IO_ACCOUNTING_CANDIDATE_V1.
